'''Kalor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] of the [[Roh tribe]], he had a wife, [[Alyak]], and two sons, [[Dubeh]] and [[Meerak]].
